meta.name: add-linear
meta.description: Add Linear channel integration via Chat SDK. Issue comment threads as conversations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 Linear 问题评论同步成聊天对话
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想把 Linear 的讨论直接搬到聊天里。
copy.tagline_en: Sync Linear issue comments into chat conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want Linear discussions to land directly in chat.

howto.what: 装好并配置后,agent 会在你指定的 Linear 团队中自动工作:任何 issue 出现新评论,它都会自动回复,不用 @ 它;每个 issue 的评论线程各自单独成为一段对话。
howto.when: 当你说“接入 Linear”“让机器人回复 Linear issue 评论”或要求配置 Linear 频道时,技能会启动,引导你填写凭据并完成接线。

say.text: 帮我把团队的 Linear issue 评论接进来,自动回复。
say.note: 技能会引导你提供凭据并完成接线。

say.text: 接入我们 ENG 团队的 Linear 频道,每条评论都回复。
say.note: 提前准备好团队 key,按提示填写即可。

say.text: 设置成不用 @ 就自动回复所有评论。
say.note: 这是该技能默认的触发模式。

howto.what_en: Once installed and configured, the agent works inside your chosen Linear team: every new comment on any issue is answered automatically, no need to @ it; each issue's comment thread stays separate as its own conversation.
howto.when_en: The skill starts when you say things like "integrate Linear", "let the bot answer Linear issue comments", or ask to set up a Linear channel. It then guides you through credentials and wiring.

say_en.text: Help me connect the team's Linear issue comments so it replies automatically.
say_en.note: It will ask for credentials and finish the wiring.

say_en.text: Connect our ENG team's Linear channel and reply to every comment.
say_en.note: Have the team key ready and follow the prompts.

say_en.text: Set it up so it auto-replies to every comment without an @.
say_en.note: This is the skill's default trigger mode.
